title: Revenue by region and month
description: Paid invoices, billed revenue and average invoice (USD) for each region and month. Reads daily_revenue and regions.

args.sql:
SELECT r.region, r.hub, substr(d.day, 1, 7) AS month,
  SUM(d.invoices) AS invoices,
  ROUND(SUM(d.revenue), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(d.revenue) / SUM(d.invoices), 2) AS avg_invoice
FROM daily_revenue d JOIN regions r ON r.region = d.region
GROUP BY r.region, r.hub, month
ORDER BY month, revenue DESC
